item.title: BALAGARH PROJECT OF KOLKATA PORT
item.description: To accommodate anticipated traffic growth and reduce intra-city cargo movement, Syama Prasad Mookerjee Port Authority (SMPA) is developing dedicated container and coal berths at Balagarh.
